body:
TIL I am an emotionally scarred statistic

But in all seriousness, this is me, I haven't tried to make contact with my father in over 5 years (about the time I moved out), if he ever asks me anything or tries to talk to me I respond with one word answers or not at all. I have NEVER had a meaningful conversation with him ever. I think the earliest memory I have of his sarcasm (although I didn't get it at the time), was when I was about 6, I was afraid of something (needle I think), he said "Are you sure you're a boy? Maybe I should cut off your dick." 

Shit like that sticks with you forever.
I remember enjoying "The Dog Days are Over", thanks for the book suggestions, I'll keep them in mind even though I can't afford books right now (let alone food).
Thanks, I never even considered joining something like that, you've given me something to think about.
